trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: يَا مَنْ يَّكْفِيْ كُلَّ مَئُوْنَةٍ بِلَا مَئُوْنَةٍ يَا جَوَادُ يَا مَاجِدُ يَا اَحَدُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهٗ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ يَا مَنْ‌ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَتَقَبَّلْ صَوْمِيْ وَاَعِنِّيْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ شَهْرِيْ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA MAIY-YAKFEE KULLA MA-OO-NATIN YAA JAWAA-DO YAA MAAJE-DO YAA AHA-DO YAA WAAHE-DO YAA SAMA-DO YAA MAN LAM YATTA-KHIZ SAAHE-BATAN WA LAA WALA-DAN WA LAM YA-KUN LAHU KOFO-WAN AHA-DOON YAA MAN LAM YALID WA-LAM YOOLAD SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA TAQAB-BAL SAWMEE A’LAIY-HE WA A’LAA MAA BAQE-YA MIN SHAREE.

trans.en: O He who removes all troubles without being troubled! O Munificent! O the Noble! O the One! O Only! O Eternal, Absolute! O the One Who begets no son, and has no partner in (His) dominion And there is none like unto Him! O He who begetteth not, nor is He begotten Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny accept my fasting and help me with it and assist me in it and during the rest of the month.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَمْسَيْتُ لَا اَمْلِكُ مَا اَرْجُوْ وَلَا اَسْتَطِيْعُ دَفْعَ مَا اُحَاذِرُ اِلَّا بِكَ وَاَمْسَيْتُ مُرْتَهَنًا بِعَمَلِيْ وَاَمْسَى الْاَمْرُ وَالْقَضَاءُ بِيَدِكَ يَا رَبِّ فَلَا فَقِيْرَ اَفْقَرُ مِنِّيْ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AM-SAIY-TO LAA AMLE-KO MAA ARJOO WA LAA AS-TATEE-O’ DAF-A’ MAA O-HAAZE-RO ILLAA BEKA WA AM-SAIY-TO MURTA-HANAN BE-A’MA-LEE WA AM-SAL AMRO WAL QAZAA-O BE-YADE-KA YAA RABBE FALAA FAQEE-RA AF-QARO MINNEE FA-SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN.

trans.en: O my God! I made it to the evening as one who cannot attain what he hopes to attain and cannot fend off what he dislikes except by You I made it to the evening while I am responsible for my own actions I made it to the evening with my destiny in Your Hand O Lord! There is no poor one poorer than me Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny.

arabic.text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ يَا رَبِّ ظُلْمِيْ وَجُرْمِيْ وَجَهْلِيْ‌ وَجِدِّيْ وَهَزْلِيْ وَكُلَّ ذَنْۢبٍ ارْتَكَبْتُهٗ وَبَلِّغْنِيْ وَارْزُقْنِيْ خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فِيْ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ الْعَظِيْمِ فِيْ غَيْرِ مَشَقَّةٍ مِنِّيْ وَلَا تُهْلِكْ رُوحِيْ وَجَسَدِيْ فِيْ طَلَبِ مَا لَمْ تُقَدِّرْ لِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: WAGH-FIR-LEE YAA RABBE ZULMEE WA JURMEE WA JAHLEE WA JIDDEE WA HAZLEE WA KULLA ZAMBIR TAKAB-TOHU WA BALLIGH-NEE WAR-ZUQNEE KHAI-RAD DUNYAA WAL AAKHE-RATE FEE HAA-ZASH SHAH-RIL A’ZEEME FEE GHAIRE MASHAQ-QATIN MINNEE WA LAA TOHLIK ROOHEE WA JASA-DEE FEE TALABE MAA LAM TO-QADDIR LEE BE-RAH-MATEKA YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O Lord! Please forgive my crimes, transgressions, ignorance, seriousness, joking and all the sins that I committed and please let me obtain and bless me with the best of this world and the Hereafter during this great month without any hardship for me And do not destroy my soul and body seeking what is not destined for me by Your Mercy O the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
